title: Wordless Directions · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Wordless Directions · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on four directions: left, right, up and down. The lead silently signals a sequence of three directions; a partner names them in order. The partner names all three directions correctly. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Wordless Directions, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The partner names all three directions correctly.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The partner names all three directions correctly.
